fields.before: PD-L1 is the tumour's side of the PD-1 brake, and also the biomarker that decides who gets immunotherapy.
fields.after: PD-L1 can bind PD-1 and limit T-cell responses. It occurs on cancer and non-cancer cells; its use as a treatment-selection biomarker depends on the drug and setting.

fields.before: PD-L1 (CD274) is the tumour-side ligand of the PD-1 brake, expressed on tumour and immune cells and induced by interferon-gamma, so its presence often marks an immune response already under way. Atezolizumab, durvalumab and avelumab block it directly. PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (22C3 CPS, SP142, 28-8) is the companion diagnostic for many indications, including CPS 10 or above for pembrolizumab in triple-negative breast cancer, with prevalence from 25 to 30 percent of NSCLC at TPS 50 percent or more to 80 to 85 percent of head and neck cancers at CPS 1 or more. Differing assays and cut-offs across drugs remain a practical source of confusion. It is now also an ADC and bispecific target (PD-L1×B7-H3 ADC BH4601, PD-L1×VEGF bispecifics). PD-L1 is both the target of immunotherapy and the test that decides who receives it.
fields.after: PD-L1 (CD274) is a ligand for PD-1 that can be expressed on cancer and non-cancer cells. Interferon gamma can induce its expression. Atezolizumab, durvalumab and avelumab block it directly. PD-L1 immunohistochemistry (22C3 CPS, SP142, 28-8) is the companion diagnostic for many indications, including CPS 10 or above for the labelled advanced triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) combinations with pembrolizumab, with prevalence from 25 to 30 percent of NSCLC at TPS 50 percent or more to 80 to 85 percent of head and neck cancers at CPS 1 or more. Differing assays and cut-offs across drugs remain a practical source of confusion. It is now also an ADC and bispecific target (PD-L1×B7-H3 ADC BH4601, PD-L1×VEGF bispecifics). PD-L1 can be a treatment target and a setting-specific biomarker. The U.S. pembrolizumab indication for high-risk early-stage TNBC has no PD-L1 qualifier; its specified advanced TNBC combinations require CPS at least 10 using an FDA-authorised test. Scoring does not determine checkpoint eligibility in every cancer or regimen.

slots.effectiveText: El lado tumoral del freno PD-1, y también el biomarcador que decide quién recibe inmunoterapia.
PD-1刹车的肿瘤侧，也是决定谁能接受免疫治疗的生物标志物。
O lado tumoral do freio PD-1, e também o biomarcador que decide quem recebe imunoterapia.
PD-1 ब्रेक का ट्यूमर वाला पक्ष, और वह बायोमार्कर भी जो तय करता है कि किसे इम्यूनोथेरेपी मिले।
PD-L1 est le versant tumoral du frein PD-1, et aussi le biomarqueur qui décide qui reçoit une immunothérapie.
PD-L1 ist die Seite des Tumors an der PD-1-Bremse und zugleich der Biomarker, der entscheidet, wer eine Immuntherapie bekommt.
PD-L1はPD-1というブレーキの腫瘍側の部分であり、誰が免疫療法を受けるかを決めるバイオマーカーでもあります。
PD-L1 هو جانب الورم من مكبح PD-1، وهو أيضاً المؤشر الحيوي الذي يحدد من يتلقى العلاج المناعي.
